text:
mia: quick check — planning to enable `spec_decoding` + `flash_attn` path for kernel-v2 on a canary audience tomorrow 10:00 PT. goal: validate perf + correctness on short-sequence gen. anyone see a hard blocker?

kevin: quick heads-up — KV cache prefetch semantics need the `kv_cache_prefetch` flag set to `adaptive` for this kernel. also will bump the prefetch threshold to 8 for low-latency paths. without that we see higher stall p99 on multi-turn.

sophia: +1 but suggest smaller audience: start with 5% not 10%. we should gate with explicit guardrails: `p95_token_latency`, `error_rate`, and `oom_count`. can we add auto-rollback triggers?

jordan: pinging code review: I have a config PR to wire the rollout and guardrails — https://stash.redwood/REPO/pull/428. snippet of rollout config in the PR:```yaml
rollout:
  audience: canary-opt-5pct
  flags:
    spec_decoding: true
    flash_attn: true
    kv_cache_prefetch: adaptive
  rollback_conditions:
    - metric: p95_token_latency_ms
      delta_pct: 15
    - metric: error_rate
      absolute_pct: 0.5
```

ops-bot: scheduled rollout created by mia — ID r-1955520000. Canary window: 60m. Notifying alerting and tracing integrations. (links: dashboard /rollouts/r-1955520000, PR https://stash.redwood/REPO/pull/428) :robot_face:

mia: thanks — updated plan: start 5% at 10:00 PT, 1-hour window, auto-rollback if p95 increases >15% or error_rate >0.5% within that window. also require kernel fallback to `kernel-v1` on rollback. request to dev-exec: run `regression_prompt_set_v3` and sample 200 completions during canary.

kevin: will add the guardrail hooks to the runtime config and the short-circuit path that disables `spec_decoding` if kv cache eviction rate > 0.1 per min. I'll post the runtime change list in the PR.

sophia: adding observability ask: create a focused dashboard for r-1955520000 with these panels: token latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, OOMs, GPU mem growth, KV cache hit ratio. add an alert rule that pages if p95 latency rises > 20ms absolute or error_rate > 0.5%.

jordan: ops checklist in PR description updated: smoke tests, regen prompts, canary observers list (mia, kevin, sophia, jordan). also added a `--dry-run` flag to the rollout script for staging verification:```bash
./tooling/rollout --id r-1955520000 --dry-run
```

ops-bot: rollout r-1955520000: preflight checks passed (infra, quotas, tracing). No active incidents blocking.

mia: awesome. who will be on-call for the canary window? @kevin?

kevin: I can be on-call for first 30m. @sophia will take second 30m?

sophia: yep, I'll take 30–60m. leaving an alert runbook note: if auto-rollback hits, do not re-enable until kernel metrics validated and a postmortem is filed.

mia: perfect. I'll kick the rollout at 10:00 PT and share the dashboard link in this thread once it's live. thanks all :thumbsup:
